title: Open a different saved workspace in a new browser tab
outcome: Greg wants to open Empty from the saved-workspace switcher alongside the current workspace. Add a real link and explicit Open in new tab action on non-current saved rows. Preserve the saved ID and other URL context; retain existing same-tab navigation and deletion. Do not offer current-workspace duplication, copy, fork or seeding. Coordinator Fable confirmed scope and file ownership.
acceptance: Non-current rows expose native target=_blank links using the saved workspace ID. Current row exposes no such link. Native modifier/middle-click behavior remains available. Opening the link does not invoke same-tab, new-workspace, rename or delete callbacks. Focused tests pass.
disposal_reason: Backlog triage w-930e4d333f07 (Architect2 final batch 58fdd104, spot-checked by Termal::Fable2): CLOSE-DONE. Landed in 53858e4 (ancestor of master) with native-link tests; markers are in note 58fdd104. Closed by evidence; no formal acceptance evaluation was run.
